method: Scene-conditioned edit using bundled image_gen.py; gpt-image-2, high, auto; one existing Godot screenshot input.
comparison_scope: Entry-frame lighting and broad materials only. Original camera and object placement remain authoritative; assess full-resolution source and generated frame together. Ignore generated text and interaction glyph fidelity. Dialog obscures the middle; dark source limits assessment of fine background details.
visual_review: Inspected source/edit pairs in 21-case contact sheet. Broad camera and room layout are recognizable. Generative detail, lighting, labels, and small geometry may differ; exact pixel and animation fidelity is not certified.
use_restrictions: Static entry-frame design target only; source is from an earlier revision and test fixture, not a frame from the current test; no numerical quality or acceptance score is implied.
